# CG-RES-021: Response media type added

A response offers a new media type.

**Why it matters:** More negotiable media types widen what consumers may request.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `mediaType.added` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Response media type {mediaType} was added to {where}.
>
> Existing consumers keep requesting the media types they used before.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: application/xml added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {}, application/xml: {}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Response media type application/xml was added to GET /x: response 200 (application/xml).

### Does not fire: no change

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
        responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
